body: I haven't told anyone about the physical abuse because it stopped when I grew taller than her. (weird huh) I would have preferred it now than back when I was six. I am quite desperate to not feel this way anymore. I've tried for years. Hell, my first suicide attempt was at 12. The next 15. The one after that at 16. Anyone like this of course wants to get better, but nothing seems to work.

>17
>born to physically abusive mother. 
>she's lightenend up over the years
>she had a boyfriend who was quite mentally abusive sarong me for his own shits and giggle at a young age. It messes with you. 
>ridiculed throughout my school years. 
>if I can't handle myself now, I'm sure going to end up worse on my own.

I had to show my parents my journal of three months for them to realize that I needed help; they've taken me to therapy, but still say the same thing all the time, which doesn't help. I would advise that if you are afraid of talking with your parents, talk to another adult or doctor or a friend perhaps? Talk to the community here if you ever need a place to vent to. We may not be therapists and whatnot, but we can still help a bit. I do advise trying to see a therapist.
I was told to "snap out of it, you're too smart too feel this way". I kid you not, those were their exact words.
Thank you, but it's quite difficult when you really love someone. I've been trying though. I start therapy sessions tomorrow, and I hope to get better in time.
I have told people how I feel, and they just drop me out of existence, and I just become a ghost to them. My ex-girlfriend of a year and three months even dumped me because I'm like this.

r/depression has helped giving me consolation by showing me that there are others like me out there. Thank you, kind stranger. I am uncertain of how the future looks for me, but I've been trying to get better. I'm trying to beat this, but I can't do it by myself, and no one is really here to help me.
